tabs.content:
// Return Sales by ProductCategory and ProductName
RapidDelivery
| join kind = inner (FabrikamProducts) on $left.ProductKey == $right.StockItemID
| summarize 
            TotalSales = sum(todecimal(UnitPrice)), 
            TotalQuantity = sum(OrderQuantity) 
        by StockGroupName, StockItemName
| project-rename ProductCategory = StockGroupName, ProductName = StockItemName
| order by TotalSales desc
